name: com.alpershin.vat
description: Bakes Unity animation clips into vertex animation textures and plays them back on URP shaders, so a whole crowd animates from one material and one instanced draw call. Ships an editor baker with preview window, a runtime crowd player and lit/unlit VAT shaders.

samples.description: Benchmark scene comparing a VAT crowd against SkinnedMeshRenderer characters, with a HUD, a grid spawner and a pre-baked animation set.
